name: Swords and Submission
source:
Sword and Submission follows the journey of two young adventurers who set out to make a name for themselves but quickly realize they’re in over their heads. They’re saved by a powerful barbarian, who agrees to escort them to the capital. Unfortunately for the male adventurer, the barbarian woman has some interesting ideas about how men should be treated.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=2418744]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《剑与屈服》讲述了两名年轻冒险家的旅程，他们打算为自己出名，但很快意识到自己陷入了困境。他们被一个强大的野蛮人救了，并同意护送他们到首都。对于男性冒险家来说不幸的是，野蛮女人对于如何对待男性有一些有趣的想法。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=2418744]Patreon[/url]]
